rumor.dark_berth_1.text: Some ships don't broadcast an ID and some ports don't care who you are. How do they disable their transponder? Those dark ships and ports don't like to share much. Finding someone to speak with will need patience and connections. I should ask around.
rumor.dark_berth_2.text: I know of a few ports that don't check your creds... Deadfall, Whisper, Ember, and Wolf 359 b come to mind. Lots of black-market goods pass through those ports. Obviously, these are pirates using them.
rumor.dark_berth_3.text: Yeah, I'm not going to broadcast my name to all. They track everything! They don't need to know that I frequent Wolf 359 b. You want to be free too? Ask around on Whisper.
rumor.dark_berth_4.text: I know the guy, yeah. You're giving me good info, I can trust you. You can find him right here on Whisper. He hangs around by the containers south of the bounty office sometimes. Tell him The Hush sent you.
